# World Socialist Web Site

> > The World Socialist Web Site provides Marxist analysis of international politics, working-class struggles, and the fight for socialism through daily news coverage, theory, and political education.

WSWS is the publication of the International Committee of the Fourth International (ICFI) and the Socialist Equality Party (US), offering socialist perspective on labor strikes, imperialism, and revolutionary politics. The site combines current events analysis with a comprehensive Marxist library and daily audio podcast.

## Key Topics

- Marxist analysis
- Fourth International
- Socialist Equality Party
- International Committee of the Fourth International (ICFI)
- Working-class struggles
- Labor strikes and organizing
- Rank-and-file committees
- Anti-war movement
- US imperialism
- Israel-Palestine conflict
- Capitalism and inequality
- Leon Trotsky
- Revolutionary theory
- Autoworker organizing
- International solidarity

## Core Content & Organization

- [World Socialist Web Site - Homepage](https://www.wsws.org/en): Homepage of WSWS with Marxist analysis, international politics and socialist content
- [Socialist Equality Party (US)](https://www.wsws.org/en/special/pages/sep): About Socialist Equality Party, its organization and revolutionary political program

## Global Class Struggle & Labor

- [Global class struggle](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/site_area/workers): Coverage of global class struggles, labor movements and rank-and-file worker organizing
- [Autoworkers](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/workersCategory/na-auto): Coverage of autoworker organizing, labor struggles and rank-and-file committees
- [Capitalism and inequality](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/socialIssuesCategory/ineq-us): Analysis of capitalism, wealth inequality, homelessness and class struggle in US

## International Politics & Anti-War

- [War and militarism](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/militarismCategory/us-milit): Coverage of US imperialism, war, militarism and anti-war movement analysis
- [Stop Israel's genocide in Gaza!](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/militarismCategory/israeli-war-on-palestine): Coverage and analysis of Israel-Palestine conflict and Gaza genocide from socialist view
- [Stop the imperialist war of extermination against Iran!](https://www.wsws.org/en/special/pages/stop-the-imperialist-war-of-extermination-against-iran-live.html): Emergency webinar on anti-war organizing against US imperialism and Iran conflict

## Theory, History & Education

- [Marxist Library](https://www.wsws.org/en/special/pages/library.html): Marxist and Trotskyist documents, theory and historical texts from ICFI organizations
- [History](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/site_area/history): Historical archive covering Marxist history, Trotsky, Fourth International and labor history
- [SEP 2025 Summer School](https://www.wsws.org/en/special/pages/sep-2025-summer-school.html): Political education summer school on Trotskyism, Fourth International and theory

## Media & Analysis

- [WSWS daily audio podcast](https://www.wsws.org/en/special/podcast): Daily audio podcast covering news, labor strikes and socialist political perspective
- [Videos](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/site_area/videos): Video archive of socialist lectures, political analysis and international events
- [Arts and Culture](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/site_area/arts): Film reviews, music, theater, books and cultural criticism from Marxist perspective
- [The coronavirus pandemic](https://www.wsws.org/en/topics/event/coronavirus): Socialist analysis of COVID-19 pandemic, public health and capitalist response

## Support & Engagement

- [Donate to the World Socialist Web Site!](https://www.wsws.org/en/special/pages/donate.html): Donation and fundraising appeal for WSWS and socialist political work
- [Contact us](https://www.wsws.org/en/special/pages/contact.html): Contact form and feedback for World Socialist Web Site and affiliated organizations
